senses.gloss: ) f. (= שוחתא; cmp. שׁוּחַ) trap made of frame work or a block.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:17">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>ההוא ש׳ דהוו וכ׳</he> two men had a dispute about a trap (and the animals caught in it).

<cite ref="Shabbat 124b:4">Sabb. 124ᵇ</cite> <he>אייתו ליה ש׳ וכ׳</he> bring a trap for Kahana to sit on; <he>הכי אמר להו שקולו ש׳ וכ׳</he> thus he said to them, remove the trap to make room for Kahana.
